aiStudioHub.title: AI Studio
aiStudioHub.subtitle: Yenza umxholo wemveliso, imifanekiso, ne-SEO nge-AI — yakhelwe kuwo onke amafom evenkileni yakho.
aiStudioHub.statusNotConfiguredHint: Yongeza isitshixo sakho se-OpenAI API kwiZicwangciso → AI (okanye umisele i-OPENAI_API_KEY kwi-environment) ukuvula iinkonzo ze-AI.
aiStudioHub.showcaseSubtitle: Tsala isilayidi — ukuphucula ngokucofa kanye kwi-AI Image Studio.
aiStudioHub.showcaseCaption: Susa okusemva, phucula, yandisa umgangatho, cima izinto, tshintsha usayizi, kwaye wandise — okanye chaza nayiphi na ukuhlelwa ngamazwi alula.
aiStudioHub.cardProductContentDescription: Velisa izihloko, iziqinisekiso ezifutshane, neenkcazo ezizotyiweyo kwisiphakamiso esifutshane.
aiStudioHub.cardProductGraphicsDescription: Vula imidiya yemveliso kwi-AI Image Studio ukuhlela okanye ukuvelisa imifanekiso.
aiStudioHub.cardSeoDescription: Zalisa izihloko zokukhangela, iinkcazo ze-meta, ii-handle, kunye nee-tag ngokucofa kanye.
aiStudioHub.cardBlogDescription: Bhala iposti epheleleyo kunye nesishwankathelo, umfanekiso ophambili, ne-SEO.
aiStudioHub.cardAssetsDescription: Velisa imifanekiso yeekati, iiayikhoni, iilogo zophawu, kunye nezembozo zeengqokelela.
aiStudioHub.cardHeroDescription: Velisa iibhena ezibanzi zevenkile ezilinganiselwe ngokuchanekileyo kwiphepha lakho lasekhaya.
aiStudioHub.everywhereSubtitle: Khangela iqhosha le-AI kwiimveliso, iikati, iingqokelela, iimpawu, iiposti zebhlog, uphononongo, kunye nomakhi wephepha lasekhaya.
aiStudioHub.howStep2: Cofa iqhosha le-AI kwindawo yedatha okanye kwimidiya
